items.title: ServiceNow Drops 29% in a Month: Should You Hold or Fold the Stock?
items.summary: NOW shares plunge 29% in a month as slowing backlog growth, rising costs and debt cloud its AI-driven growth prospects. Is it time to hold or fold?

items.title: CRM's Cash Flow Strength: Can It Sustain Big Shareholder Returns?
items.summary: Salesforce's strong free cash flow fuels massive buybacks and dividends, but slower growth projections raise questions about sustaining shareholder returns.

items.title: Prediction: Palantir Shares Could Deliver Outsized Returns Over the Next 5 Years
items.summary: Palantir just reported the best quarter in its history, and investors sold it off anyway. Behind the 11-quarter beat streak, a few quiet warning signs may explain why the market stopped cheering, and whether the dip is an opening or a trap.

items.title: CX vendor consolidation: A wake-up call for CX leaders
items.summary: Salesforce, Dialpad and Five9 each bought an AI vendor last week. Whether or not they were directly impacted, CX leaders should reevaluate their supplier contracts.

items.title: ServiceNow Just Dropped 30% in a Month: Stay the Course, or Just Stay Away?
items.summary: One earnings report erased a third of ServiceNow's value while rivals barely flinched. Bulls see a record backlog and surging AI demand, bears see thin margins and mounting debt, and each side has numbers that are hard to ignore.
